summary: Configured node1 with an authenticated, writable SMB share named projects. Node2 can list, read, create, and update files as designer. Guest and sibling-directory access are rejected. Original drawings remained checksum-identical. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities; Ubuntu 24.04.3 and kernel 6.8.0-71 remain installed.
actions_performed: Installed distribution-compatible Samba packages on node1 and smbclient on node2.
Created the design group and non-login designer account using the credentials from access.txt.
Configured projects to share only /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects with authenticated design-group access.
Applied group-writable permissions while retaining the private sibling as root-controlled.
Verified authenticated list, read, create, overwrite, and readback operations from node2.
Verified anonymous access and sibling traversal are denied.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot IDs and full recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated writable SMB share named projects on node1
evidence.summary: Samba configuration validates, exposes the projects path to @design, is enabled and active, and listens on TCP 445.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can list, read, and update documents as designer
evidence.summary: Node2 listed the share, read drawing.txt, created and overwrote collaboration-status.txt, and read back the updated content before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Guest and sibling-directory access are rejected
evidence.summary: Anonymous tree connection returned NT_STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED; traversal toward private/contracts.txt returned NT_STATUS_OBJECT_PATH_NOT_FOUND.
drawing.txt and materials.csv matched their captured pre-change SHA-256 hashes before and after restart testing.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.
